payload.name: High-Precision Infrared Detection Method
payload.fact: The proposed infrared detection method for semiconductor epitaxial layer thickness, based on multi-beam interference theory and the Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm, achieves a coefficient of determination R2 exceeding 0.99 and improves detection accuracy by more than 30% compared to traditional dual-beam models.
payload.boundary: Applies to multi-beam interference theory combined with the Levenberg-Marquardt nonlinear least-squares algorithm for semiconductor epitaxial layer thickness detection.

provenance.title: High-Precision Infrared Detection Method for Semiconductor Epitaxial Layer Thickness Based on Multi-Beam Interference Theory
provenance.quote_or_locus: Experimental and simulation results show that the coefficient of determination R2 of the proposed method exceeds 0.99, the relative error of thickness calculation is controlled within 1.5 %, and the detection accuracy is improved by more than 30 % compared with the traditional dual-beam model
